target.statement: Mean accuracy of Quant on the 112 UCR datasets subset (0.8671) or on a single small UCR dataset (e.g., GunPoint) to verify the method's accuracy.
target.table_ref: Figure 1 (MCM) or Figure 6 (MCM) mean accuracy for Quant
target.dataset: UCR Time Series Classification Archive (112 or 142 datasets)

compute.basis: The method is a simple feature transform (quantiles over fixed intervals) plus extremely randomized trees; the paper reports <15 min total for 142 datasets on one CPU core, so a single small dataset or the 112-dataset subset should run in minutes on a laptop.

title: QUANT: A Minimalist Interval Method for Time Series Classification
